entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'd like to start a return for an order I received last week.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Of course. The name is Alex Chen, order number 774-B-912.

Thank you, Alex. I see your order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered 8 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's just a preference thing. The color online looked like a matte gray, but in person, it's much shinier than I expected. The box is unopened, so it's in perfect condition.
I understand completely. Getting the right color is important. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.

Okay, I've pulled up the policy. Since the helmet was delivered just 8 days ago, you are well within the 90-day return window. I've gone ahead and approved this return for you. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email on file right now.

That's great, thank you. I do plan on ordering a different helmet from you, since VeloFit's commitment to safety is the best in the business. Since I have to go through this process, is there any chance you could offer a small discount code for my next purchase?

I appreciate your loyalty, Alex, and I'm happy to hear you're sticking with us. I see here that you're a VIP member. For the inconvenience, I can absolutely add a 15% discount to your account that you can apply to your next order.
Perfect, that's exactly what I was hoping for. You've been a great help, Sarah.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
